output.text: The community garden meeting drew a small crowd on a breezy Saturday morning. Mina arrived first, carrying a box of seed packets she had sorted the night before. Assume that Ben is the treasurer. Leo showed up a few minutes later, still in his work boots from the morning shift at the nursery. Dev came in right after, apologizing for being late because his bike had a flat tire. Gus booked the hall. Ben, who is the oldest of the group, greeted everyone warmly and asked about the compost bins. Mina is on the same team as Leo, and the two of them spent the first half hour discussing which vegetables to plant along the back fence. Dev is taller than Gus, though Gus insists his boots make up the difference. Leo is not on the same team as Dev, a fact that came up naturally when they were assigning watering schedules for the week. Ben mentioned that the tool shed needed a new lock before the weekend. Mina is not on the same team as Dev, which meant the planting schedule had to be arranged carefully so nobody overlapped on chores. Gus, who ranks just behind Ben in seniority among the volunteers, offered to bring extra gloves next time. Leo and Ben compared notes on which rows had the best drainage after last week's rain. By the end of the meeting, everyone had a task, and the garden beds looked ready for the coming season.
